content.short: QR coin runs daily on-chain auctions for the website a single QR code points to.
content.description: QR coin is an on-chain attention auction: each day bidders compete to decide which website one QR code links to, with proceeds tied to the QR token. It began on Base and runs a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: QR coin auctions the destination of one QR code each day on-chain, with a World App mini app.
content.pageTitle: QR coin - Web3 Social Dapps - Lancers Web3 Explorer
